text:
amanda: FYI I'm planning a canary rollout for Zephyr-13B-v2 into the model catalog tomorrow. Thinking a small canary on dedicated-capacity first, then widen if smoke looks good. Who can own the actual deploy and the smoke checks?

kevin: I can do the catalog pin + deploy orchestration. Prefer to run it in the 14:00-16:00 PT window so EMEA overlap is minimal.

sara: I can run smoke tests and take on-call for the 2h window after canary starts. Need the smoke checklist though.

amanda: Awesome — kevin will pin+deploy, sara runs smoke. jen can you confirm product gating/allowed prompts to test?

jen: Yep — I'll post the canonical prompt set in this thread in a sec. Priorities: safety checks, hallucination spot-checks on the new instruction-following prompts, and basic perf (p50/p95).

kevin: For rollback plan: we'll point routes from zephyr-13b-v2 -> zephyr-13b-v1 if anything crosses thresholds. I will keep a manual rollback ready and a config diff in the rollout PR.

sara: Smoke pass criteria proposal: p50 latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms under canary load (5rps), no tokenization/malformed outputs on top-10 prompts, and no new safety hits on the test set. If any one fails, rollback.

amanda: Sounds good. Also want a quality regression quick-check: run eval harness on 200 curated prompts and require >= 98% pass rate on exact-match/required intents. jen will confirm the list.

kevin: I'll open the catalog PR now and request review from amanda + infra. PR will include: pin entry, container digest, change-log notes, and canary traffic % (10%).

jen: Prompt set (short):
1) "Summarize this policy in 2 sentences"
2) "Convert the bullet list to a JSON object"
3) instruction-follow: "Write a polite error message for invalid input"
(Full list in the PR comments)

sara: Quick smoke commands I'm planning to run: 
```bash
# sample gen
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"zephyr-13b-v2","input":"Summarize this policy in 2 sentences"}' | jq .

# latency load (small)
wrk -t2 -c10 -d30s -s ./scripts/gen.lua https://canary.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

kevin: Deploy bot scheduled a job id when I kicked off the pipeline:
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: id=dep_20260318_42 url=https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/dep_20260318_42 status=queued

amanda: Can we add a trace hook for tokenization errors (tokenizer logs) and hook into the console dashboard for the canary? Need per-request tokenization error counter.

sara: I'll add alerts for tokenizer_errors > 0 and safety_hits > 0 in the first 30m. If either fires we cut traffic.

kevin: PR: https://git.redwood.example/r/model-catalog/pulls/1859 (draft). I'll notify infra for the infra rollout plan once reviews land.

amanda: Excellent. Final checklist for tomorrow: kevin pins + create PR, jen posts full prompts, sara runs smoke, amanda monitors quality dashboards, rollback target = zephyr-13b-v1.

kevin: marking owners: deploy=kevin, smoke=sara, product=jen, qa=amanda. I'll update PR and schedule the canary at 14:30 PT tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Deployment job started: id=dep_20260318_42 status=running logs=https://ci.redwood.example/logs/dep_20260318_42

sara: I'll start smoke run at job start, posting quick summary here in thread (+ pass/fail and p50/p95).

amanda: Thanks all. If anyone sees anything odd ping @sara and I'll join the console. :thumbsup:
